som.lead: A steady background sound, with no voice and no music, to help you concentrate. Pick one and set the volume.
som.honesto: Sounds made on your device. Free music will come in once the curators have checked its licence.

marrom.descricao: Deep and muffled, like a distant rumble.

chuva.descricao: Filtered noise that rises and falls, like rain on the roof.

som.voz: When a lesson's voice starts reading, the sound drops to 30% and comes back afterwards.

hoje.lead: A script of about two minutes to listen to or read: what happened on this day and the lesson of the week.
hoje.abrirAula: Open the lesson of the week
hoje.vozDoAparelho: Read by your device's voice: the text is not sent to anyone.

roteiro.saudacao: Hello! Today is {data}. This is Today on campus, from the Lúcia Maria School.
roteiro.fatosAbre: On this day, in the history of the people's struggle:
roteiro.aula: The lesson of the week is “{titulo}”, from the track {trilha}. {resumo} It takes about {minutos} minutes.
roteiro.fechamento: That's all for today. Happy studying, and see you tomorrow.

ouvir.baixarVoz: The chosen voice is not on this device yet: {tamanho} to download. Download now?
ouvir.semVoz: This device has no voice to read aloud.

cordel.lead: The lesson in cordel verse: six-line stanzas of seven syllables, to read aloud, print and pass on.
cordel.rascunho: Draft under review: check it against the lesson
cordel.rascunhoTexto: These verses summarise the lesson and have not yet been reviewed by an educator. The lesson text is what counts.
cordel.baseado: Based on the lesson “{titulo}”, from the track {trilha}.
cordel.imprimirDica: When printing, choose A5 paper (or A4 with “two pages per sheet”).
